survey: A tall tumbler of orange iced drink stands on a purple tabletop. The camera is a little above the rim. The table's back edge is a level horizontal line behind the glass, and the tabletop is seen slightly from above. The glass is a slightly tapered cylinder. Its rim is a fairly narrow ellipse. The liquid surface just below it is a similar ellipse, and the thick base at the bottom is a slightly fuller ellipse, as it should be since it sits further below eye level. The side walls taper evenly toward the base and are mirror images of each other. A pink bendy straw leans in at the back-left of the rim, crosses the liquid diagonally to the front-right near the base, and bends outward above the rim at its pleated joint. A paper cocktail umbrella on a wooden stick rests on the back-right of the rim. Its canopy is a cone seen slightly from the side and below, tilted to match the angle of the stick. Ice cubes float at different angles, and each one is drawn as a believable cube in the same view. The base sits flat on the tabletop, with a soft shadow that lies along the table plane.
